exact_statement: For every labelled bipartite H of maximum degree at most two on sides 2<=a<=b, the positive edge DNF for G=K_ab minus H, with its original surviving edge primes, both endpoint orders, pi=1/4 and fixed lambda_e=1/b, has complete nonempty posterior all-partition forest cost C<42 I(f) when G is nonempty; if a>=4, C<(283/8)I(f)<36I(f). The empty G case is constant and handled separately. More generally for any G on 4<=a<=b with every left degree>=b/2 and right degree>=a/2, the same reference satisfies C<(91/8)I(f)+2J log2 b, where J is the total physical flip influence of the indicator of assignments having nonempty active sets on both sides and no active surviving G edge.
